subject: Golem Cave
text: Entering and completing Golem Cave requires 1 Mattock and 2 Keys.

evidence.quote: Items Needed: 1 Mattock, 2 Keys

subject: Golem Cave
text: Golem Cave contains many screens that will warp the player back to the first screen.

evidence.quote: This cave contains many screens that warp you back to the first screen.

subject: Floor 1
text: On Floor 1, head north, east twice, break the north wall with a Mattock, and proceed north and west.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Go north, east twice, and use a Mattock on the north wall. Go north and then west.

subject: Floor 1 door puzzle
text: Place one treasure box onto an odd tile and knock it off to unlock the door.

evidence.quote: On this screen there are four treasure chests and four odd tiles. Place one treasure box onto a tile and then knock it off the tile to open the door.

subject: Floor 1
text: Head north, east, open the door with a Key, then go east, south three times, east twice, and up the stairs to Floor 2.

evidence.quote: Go north and then east. Use a Key to open the door and go through it. Go east, south three times, east twice and up the stairs.

subject: Floor 2
text: On Floor 2 before going east to start the battle, save the game and heal.

evidence.quote: * Floor 2 * Now save your game and heal-up. Go east to begin the

subject: Cyclops
text: The recommended level to fight Cyclops is 37.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Cyclops
Recommended Level:  37

subject: Cyclops
text: Defeating Cyclops yields 63 GP and 71 EXP.

evidence.quote:
GP:                 63
EXP gained:         71

subject: Cyclops
text: The best equipment for battling Cyclops is the Were Axe and Cure Spell.

evidence.quote: Best Equipment:     Were Axe, Cure Spell

subject: Cyclops
text: Stay below Cyclops when he charges horizontally across the screen and hit him with the Were Axe, then move above him when he hits the bottom and strike as he moves up.

evidence.quote: Stay below him as he charges across the screen and use the Were Axe to hit him. Once he reaches the bottom of the screen go above him. Then hit him as he makes his way up. Follow this general pattern until the monster is defeated.

subject: Cyclops
text: Open the treasure chest left after defeating Cyclops to obtain the Morning Star.

evidence.quote: Once he is vanquished open the treasure for a Morning Star.

subject: Morning Star
text: Equipping the Morning Star adds +10 to attack and breaks down the same objects and walls as a Mattock.

evidence.quote: Equip this weapon, which adds +10 to your attack. This weapon also is able to break down the same objects and walls your Mattock can... so you can now get rid of all your Mattocks.

subject: Floor 1
text: Return west three times to the entrance, head north, heal and save, then unlock the northern door with a Key.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Now go west three times and you will be back at the entrance. Go north, heal-up and save your game. Use a Key on the door

subject: Golem
text: The recommended level for Golem is 39.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Golem
Recommended Level:  39

subject: Golem
text: Defeating Golem awards 96 GP and 172 EXP.

evidence.quote:
GP:                 96
EXP gained:         172

subject: Golem
text: The Morning Star and Cure Spell are the best equipment for fighting Golem.

evidence.quote: Best Equipment:     Morning Star, Cure Spell

subject: Golem
text: Remain at the bottom of the screen during the entire battle, sidestep when Golem charges downward, and strike him with the Morning Star.

evidence.quote: Stay at the bottom of the screen for the entire battle. When he charges down move out of the way and hit him with the Morning Star. Do this until the Golem dies.

subject: Golem
text: Golem drops the Spell Book of Lit upon defeat.

evidence.quote: Items Gained:       Spell Book of Lit

subject: Floor 2
text: Climb the vine on Floor 2, proceed east toward the cave until the bridge collapses, and exit next to a waterfall before heading east twice into the castle.

evidence.quote: * Floor 2 * Climb the vine and go east. Then try to go into the cave. Just as you try, the bridge behind you collapses. Your character then comes out next to a waterfall. Now go east twice and into the castle.

subject: Dark Castle
text: Navigating Dark Castle requires 3 Keys.

evidence.quote: Items Needed: 3 Keys

subject: Floor 1 entrance
text: The main gate is locked, so walk west one screen, cut down trees to head west again, then go north through the door.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Try going through the main gate to the castle and you will discover that it is locked. You need to find another entrance... so walk west a screen. Now chop some trees down and go west again. Then go north a screen and walk into the door.

subject: B-Floor 2
text: Cross the north bridge, then the west bridge, go north, east, cross the south bridge, go east, cross the north bridge, and continue east up the stairs.

evidence.quote: * B-Floor 2 * Cross the bridge to the north, then the bridge to the west, and go north. Now go east, cross the bridge to the south, east, and walk across the bridge to your north. Now go east a screen and up the stairs.

subject: Floor 1
text: Climb the vine north on Floor 1, head north on Floor 2 to reach Floor 5, then descend stairs through Floor 4 to Floor 3.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Climb the vine above you and go north a screen. * Floor 2 * Now go north another screen. * Floor 5 * (That last vine brings you up a few floors) Now go down the stairs. * Floor 4 * Go down another flight of stairs.

subject: Floor 3
text: Heal up and save your game on Floor 3 before going west to face Chimera.

evidence.quote: * Floor 3 * Now heal-up and save your game. Go west and the Chimera

subject: Chimera
text: The recommended level for defeating Chimera is 40.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Chimera
Recommended Level:  40

subject: Chimera
text: Chimera awards 21 GP and 90 EXP upon defeat.

evidence.quote:
GP:                 21
EXP gained:         90

subject: Chimera
text: Stand near the top of the screen and attack rapidly while curing occasionally to defeat Chimera as it drops bombs and flies downward in a zigzag pattern.

evidence.quote: The monster flies above you and drops two flaming bombs with its wings. Soon after doing this, the Chimera will fly down in a zigzagging type motion. The method that I used to defeat the Chimera was to simply stand near the top of the screen and attack as quickly as I could, curing occasionally.

subject: Girl
text: After defeating Chimera, descend the southwest stairs to Floor 2 to find the Girl in her prison cell, where she joins your party and can heal HP when asked.

evidence.quote: Once the monster is defeated, go down the stairs found in the southwest corner of the screen. * Floor 2 * You are now in the Girl's prison cell. The Girl will run up to you and join your group.... Remember, now that the girl is with you, she can heal your HP when you ASK her.

subject: Item Shop
text: On Floor 1, enter the building to rest on the bed and purchase supplies at the Item Shop.

evidence.quote: * Floor 1 * Then go west a screen and walk into the building. You can refresh yourself on the bed and buy whatever you need from the Item Shop.

subject: Floor 3 staircase
text: Walk across spikes, unlock the door with a Key, break the north wall, and use the Chain Flail to reach and stand on the odd tile to make stairs appear.

evidence.quote: * Floor 3 * Quickly walk across the spikes. Use a Key on the door and go north. Then go east and use a Mattock/Morning Star on the north wall. Then go north through the hole. Go west and then use the Chain Flail to cross over to the odd tile. Stand on the odd tile and a staircase will appear. Go down the stairs.

subject: Floor 2 empty chests
text: Do not knock any of the four empty chests off their odd tiles on Floor 2, or the stairs will vanish.

evidence.quote: The room here has four empty chests on the odd tiles. Do not knock any of them off or the stairs will vanish.

subject: Floor 2
text: Defeat all enemies in the room on Floor 2 and open the chest to acquire the Blood Sword.

evidence.quote: * Floor 2 * Go south, east, and kill all the enemies. Open the chest for the Blood Sword.

subject: Floor 3 snowman puzzle
text: Freeze two monsters into snowmen using the Ice spell and place them onto the odd tiles to access the stairs going down.

evidence.quote: * Floor 3 * Go south and west twice. Now freeze two monsters using the Ice spell, and put the snowmen on the odd tiles. Then go down the stairs.

subject: Dark Lord
text: The recommended level for confronting the Dark Lord is 41.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Dark Lord
Recommended Level:  41

subject: Dark Lord
text: Defeating the Dark Lord awards 167 GP and 12 EXP.

evidence.quote:
GP:                 167
EXP gained:         12

subject: Dark Lord
text: Defeating the Dark Lord yields the Fake Pendant.

evidence.quote: Items Gained:       Fake Pendant

subject: Dark Lord
text: Dodge around the Dark Lord to evade his sword and MAX attack, striking him until he is defeated.

evidence.quote: The Dark Lord will run around and try to hit you with his sword. The Dark Lord is able to use a MAX type attack with his sword and he is able to follow your movements. Dodge around him and strike him until he is defeated.

subject: Girl
text: After defeating the Dark Lord, the Girl is gone, and outside the castle Julius hypnotizes her to reverse the waterfall and zaps the hero.

evidence.quote: Go south down the stairs. The Girl is gone, mostly likely stolen away by Julius. Your character will automatically exit the castle.... Apparently, he has hypnotized the Girl! He tells the Girl to use the pendant so the waterfall will be reversed. Once the waterfall starts to flow backwards, Julius will zap you with his magical power. Your character then falls down the waterfall AGAIN!

subject: Bogard
text: The Chocobo carries the hero to Ish, where Bogard explains what happened after falling from the airship.

evidence.quote: Your Chocobo finds you and brings you to a house in Ish. You wake up and find Bogard lying in a bed next to you. Bogard tells the Hero what befell him after he fell from the airship.

subject: Sarah
text: Sarah explains that Bogard broke his back and mentions that the Chocobo is being upgraded at Doctor Bowow's house.

evidence.quote: Then talk to Sarah who is blocking your path. She says that Bogard broke his back and is unable to move. She tells the hero that he is everyone's only hope and that she believes in him. She also mentions that the Chocobo is being fixed up at Doctor Bowow's house.

subject: Chocobot
text: Dr. Bowow equips the Chocobo with mechanized legs that allow it to travel across water under its new name, Chocobot.

evidence.quote: While talking to Dr. Bowow, you will discover that your Chocobo can now go on water with his new mechanized legs. The Chocobo also has a new name, Chocobot!

subject: Bogard
text: Bogard tells the hero that the sword Excalibur is required to defeat Julius and advises returning to Wendel to consult Cibba.

evidence.quote: Bogard tells you that since Julius has Mana, you will need to find the sword Excalibur if you want to defeat him. He also tells you to go back to Wendel and ask Cibba for more information.

subject: Magic Shop
text: There is a Magic Shop west of Ish that sells X-Ethers.

evidence.quote: If you want, there is a Magic Shop west of Ish. They do sell X-Ether's there, so you might want to consider buying some.

subject: Ish to Wendel route
text: From outside Ish, go west twice, north twice, west once onto the pier into the water, east seven times, north twice to the pier, then north twice into Wendel.

evidence.quote: Otherwise, go (w,w,n,n,w) from outside of Ish. Walk onto the pier and step out into the water. Then go east seven times, north twice, and then walk onto the pier. Then go north twice and go into Wendel.

subject: Cibba
text: A girl near the top of the screen in Wendel says Cibba traveled to Lorim near the snowfields.

evidence.quote: Go north once and talk to the girl near the top of the screen. She says that Cibba went to Lorim, which is near the snowfields.

subject: Wendel to Lorim route
text: From Wendel, travel south twice to the pier, then (s,w,w,s,w,w,s,e,s,s,s,s) onto the pier, then (n,e,s,s,e,n) and into Lorim.

evidence.quote: * Now go south twice to the pier. Then (s,w,w,s,w,w,s,e,s,s,s,s, and onto the pier. Now go (n,e,s,s,e,n, and into Lorim.

subject: King of Lorim
text: The king in the throne room says Kary froze his subjects along with Cibba, tasking the hero with finding Kary.

evidence.quote: Go north into the throne room. Talk to the king and he says that Kary froze his subjects and that Cibba is also frozen. Your task now is to find Kary, but first you need to buy weapons and armor.
